prompt: How many badminton athletes have won Olympic Gold and more than 2 Olympic medals in total?
answer: 8 badminton athletes. They are Gao Ling, Fu Haifeng, Zhang Nan, Zhao Yunlei, Viktor Axelsen, Kim Dong-moon, Chen Long, and Gil Young-ah.
